name: Aurora Lightroom Presets
description: A pack of 30 hand-crafted Lightroom presets for moody, cinematic color grading. Works with Lightroom Desktop, Classic, and Mobile. One-click looks that you can fine-tune to taste.

reviews.author: Maya R.
reviews.text: These completely changed the mood of my photos. Worth every cent.

reviews.author: Daniel K.
reviews.text: One click and my feed looks cohesive. My favorite purchase this year.

name: Focus — Notion Productivity Template
description: An all-in-one Notion workspace for tasks, projects, habits, and weekly reviews. Duplicate it into your own Notion in one click and start planning immediately.

reviews.author: Ori T.
reviews.text: Finally a system I actually stick with. Clean and simple.

reviews.author: Sara L.
reviews.text: Great structure out of the box, easy to customize.

name: Nova UI Kit for Figma
description: A production-ready Figma UI kit with 200+ components, auto-layout, variables, and light/dark themes. Build interfaces in a fraction of the time.

reviews.author: Noa B.
reviews.text: Saved me at least two weeks on my last project. Incredible value.

reviews.author: Tom W.
reviews.text: The auto-layout setup alone is worth the price.

name: Pixel Icon Set
description: 500 pixel-perfect SVG icons in a consistent stroke style. Includes outline and filled variants, plus a web font. Drop them into any project, royalty-free.

reviews.author: Lior A.
reviews.text: Consistent, clean, and huge variety. My go-to icon set now.

reviews.author: Emma S.
reviews.text: Great quality and the web font makes them easy to use.

name: The Freelancer's Playbook (eBook)
tagline: Land clients and price your work
description: A practical 120-page guide to finding clients, pricing projects, writing proposals, and getting paid on time. Includes templates for contracts and invoices.

reviews.author: Adam P.
reviews.text: Paid for itself with the very first client I landed using it.

reviews.author: Rina M.
reviews.text: Straight to the point, no fluff. The templates are gold.

name: Lo-Fi Sound Pack
description: 120 royalty-free lo-fi loops, one-shots, and textures at 24-bit WAV. Perfect for beats, videos, and podcasts. Fully cleared for commercial use.

reviews.author: Jay D.
reviews.text: Warm, clean samples that sit right in the mix. Love them.

reviews.author: Kayla F.
reviews.text: Perfect for my podcast intros. Huge time saver.

name: Resume Template Pack
description: Five clean, recruiter-approved resume templates that pass applicant tracking systems. Editable in Word, Google Docs, and Figma, with a matching cover letter.

reviews.author: Michael G.
reviews.text: Landed three interviews the week after switching to this template.

reviews.author: Dana V.
reviews.text: Looks professional and passed the ATS scan. Easy to edit.

name: Next.js SaaS Starter Kit
description: A batteries-included Next.js starter with authentication, Stripe billing, a dashboard, and email — all wired up. Skip weeks of boilerplate and ship your SaaS faster.

reviews.author: Ben H.
reviews.text: Shipped my MVP in a weekend instead of a month. Unreal.

reviews.author: Priya N.
reviews.text: The billing integration alone saved me days of work.
